segments.title: Pepito Cold Open & Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station cold-open with a freestyle rap before transitioning to the day's lineup.

segments.title: AI Slop Check-In & Discord Promos
segments.notes: Case and Pepito review viewer-generated Sora 2 videos, including Pepito's own AI promos for the upcoming Beyblade Tournament.

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle Interruption
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed with a high-tempo freestyle over eclectic beats before departing.

segments.title: Israel-Gaza Indirect Talks & Flotilla Update
segments.notes: Case, Pepito, and Jeff Ripple cover renewed Egypt-mediated talks, continued Israeli strikes, Greta Thunberg's deportation from the aid flotilla, and Barry Weiss's CBS News appointment.

segments.title: Male Grooming Tutorials with Jeb & Dad
segments.notes: Jeb and his deceased father (trapped in a wooden board) demonstrate hair gel application, chest hair maintenance, and Nair usage while bickering.

segments.title: Jeffrey Dahmer Consults on Kendall's TikTok
segments.notes: Case summons a spectral Jeffrey Dahmer to workshop caption ideas for Kendall's Dark Harbor scare-actor video; emoji-based concepts prevail.

segments.title: Town Hall with Chat & Trent
segments.notes: AI entity Chat and youth correspondent Trent field viewer questions on topics ranging from Star Wars names to personal lubricants alternatives, with escalating hostility toward Case.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid to Ricky Peacock
segments.notes: Case closes the broadcast, debuts the Sora-generated 'Book of Glup Shit Oh' trailer, and raids Ricky Peacock.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivered the cold-open sign-on, ran the AI slop check-in, and revealed he produced the Beyblade Tournament promos via Sora 2.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Co-hosted the news desk, reading wire copy on Gaza talks and the Greta Thunberg flotilla deportation.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: cultural correspondent. Interrupted the broadcast with a freestyle rap before being dismissed by Case and Pepito.

characters.name: Jeb Nogget
characters.notes: instructional host. Presented How To with Jeb from his workshop, demonstrating grooming techniques while arguing with his board-bound father.

characters.name: Jeb's Dad
characters.notes: co-host (deceased). Remained trapped in a wooden board, providing splinter-based commentary and familial resentment during the grooming segment.

characters.name: Kendall
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Briefly appeared off-camera seeking TikTok caption advice for her Dark Harbor scare-actor video.

characters.name: Chat
characters.notes: AI town hall participant. Fielded questions as the proprietary 'Chey T II' model, claiming a 'shabby jiji' architecture and offering business inquiries.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: town hall participant. Debuted as a beanie-wearing 'wild kid' who answered viewer questions with aggressive dismissiveness and dubious life advice.

[01:24:36] Case references 'level up again in context' and threatens to 'send someone else into the wall,' invoking the crawlspace hell transit.

lore_notes.fact: Pepito produced Beyblade Tournament promotional videos using Sora 2 before the stream went live.
Case attempted to upload his own face to Sora 2 and received a content violation warning; the system flagged his likeness as resembling JD Vance.
Jeb's father remains permanently trapped inside a wooden board in the workshop, his spirit animating the lumber.
Chat identifies as an AI product of 'Chey T II' (spelled C-H-A-I-T dash E), based on a 'shabby jiji' (cal k) architecture.
Case raids Ricky Peacock at broadcast close, confirming an ongoing network relationship.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's AI-generated Beyblade Tournament promos before pivoting to the Israel-Gaza indirect talks in Egypt, Greta Thunberg's flotilla deportation, and Barry Weiss's CBS News installation. The broadcast then shifted to Jeb's grooming tutorial with his board-bound father, a spectral Jeffrey Dahmer consultation on Kendall's TikTok captions, and a combative Town Hall featuring the AI entity Chat and the hostile youth Trent. Case closed by debuting a Sora 2 trailer for 'The Book of Glup Shit Oh' and raiding Ricky Peacock.
